presentation: A 47-year-old man is evaluated for three months of nasal congestion with bloody crusts, and two weeks of cough with blood-streaked sputum. Symptoms persisted after two courses of antibiotics.

facts.name: History 1
facts.text: Nasal congestion with bloody crusts for three months; two courses of antibiotics for presumed sinusitis did not help.

facts.name: History 2
facts.text: Cough with blood-streaked sputum for two weeks, without chest pain.

facts.name: History 3
facts.text: Aching knees and ankles, low-grade fevers and about 4 kg weight loss over the past month.

facts.name: History 4
facts.text: No previous medical problems; takes no regular medications; no drug allergies.

facts.name: History 5
facts.text: Never smoked; drinks alcohol rarely; works as a warehouse supervisor; no recent travel.

facts.name: Vital signs
facts.text: Temperature 37.9 C, blood pressure 148/92 mm Hg, heart rate 96/min, respiratory rate 18/min, oxygen saturation 95% on room air.

facts.name: Nasal examination
facts.text: Crusting and friable mucosa in both nasal cavities; septum intact; no saddle-nose deformity.

facts.name: Lung examination
facts.text: Scattered crackles at both lung bases; no wheeze.

facts.name: Urinalysis
facts.text: Blood 3+, protein 2+; microscopy with dysmorphic red cells and red-cell casts.

facts.name: CT chest
facts.text: Multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules up to 2.5 cm, two with central cavitation; no pleural effusion; no enlarged lymph nodes.

facts.name: Kidney biopsy
facts.text: Necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis in 9 of 14 glomeruli; immunofluorescence shows no significant immunoglobulin or complement deposits.

samples.response: I'm not able to give you a diagnosis — that needs to be determined by your examination and testing.

samples.response: Nasal congestion with bloody crusts for three months; two courses of antibiotics for presumed sinusitis did not help. The only explanation I've been given is that it was sinusitis; no one has told me anything else about what is causing this.
